title: A nonanalytic collapsing locus for Chern--Ricci flow
established: An explicit Hermitian metric on $\mathbb P^1\times E$ has a nonanalytic locus of collapsing analytic subvarieties, while the total volume stays bounded below. Equality with the singular set alone is not decided.
scope_or_remaining: The conclusion concerns exactly the catalogue target; no historical priority claim is made.
author: Matthew J. Colbrook
outcome: Counterexample to the analyticity conclusion: the collapsing-subvariety locus is nonanalytic for an admissible Hermitian flow.
